title: Performance — Cabin Pressurisation and Cold Sector Cabin Environment
abstract: Flight crew performance information for cabin pressurisation and the cabin environment on long high latitude sectors, including the effect of low outside temperature on the aft cabin and the crew reporting expected.

sections.purpose: This entry gives the performance information for cabin pressurisation and describes the cabin environment effects the crew should expect on long sectors at high latitude and low outside air temperature.
sections.description: Cabin altitude is controlled automatically against a schedule derived from the cruise altitude and the destination elevation, and the maximum cabin altitude in normal operation is published in the performance tables. On long sectors at high latitude the outside air temperature stays low for many hours and the aeroplane structure cools well below the values reached on shorter routes. Cabin temperature is held to the selected values, but zones close to the aeroplane skin and services routed under the cabin floor run considerably colder than the cabin itself. Cabin crew reports of services becoming unavailable late in such sectors are common on long northern routes and are associated with the sustained low structure temperature rather than with the pressurisation system. Selecting a warmer cabin temperature does not change the temperature of a service routed under the floor.
sections.crew_procedure: Monitor cabin altitude against the schedule in the normal way. On long high latitude sectors, expect cabin crew reports of cold-related unavailability in the aft cabin late in the flight and record them in the cabin log with the elapsed time and the outside air temperature. Do not select an abnormally warm cabin temperature to compensate; it affects passenger comfort in the rest of the cabin and does not restore the affected service.
sections.limitation_note: The maximum normal cabin altitude and the differential pressure limits are in the limitations section and are unaffected by outside air temperature.

type_data.crew_action: Monitor cabin altitude; record cold-related cabin unavailability with elapsed time and outside air temperature.
